query: SELECT o.id, o.agentId, o.userId, o.agentType, o.status, o.companyId, o.completedAt, a.name as agent_name FROM agent_onboardings o LEFT JOIN agents a ON o.agentId = a.id WHERE o.userId = 1 ORDER BY o.id;
